assets.prompt_summary: Transparent cozy pixel-art mining props with timber access, rest and service fixtures, and gold-bearing rock.
assets.integration: Godot generate_mine_atlas.gd splits the source into five columns, trims transparent bounds, fits each sprite within 29×35 px with nearest sampling, and anchors them to baseline 38 in 32×40 px cells.

assets.prompt_summary: Transparent cozy pixel-art rock wall, lantern-lit timber support, and mining rail.
assets.integration: Godot generate_cavern_atlas.gd crops three source regions and fits them into bottom-aligned 64×64 px cells using nearest sampling.
Godot extracts the fifth cell at (128,0,32,40) and resizes it to a 32×32 px inventory texture using nearest sampling.

assets.prompt_summary: Open the timber mine portal by removing the blocking crossbars while preserving the surrounding pixel-art structure.
assets.integration: Godot loads the PNG and resizes it to 192×128 px using nearest sampling for the surface entrance.

Godot work/generate_mine_freight_atlas.gd trims four source segments to their alpha bounds, scales nearest to 28 px maximum and aligns within 32×32 cells. Fifth cell duplicates the loaded cart with altered wheel hubs.
assets.prompt: Transparent alpha spritesheet for TuanIsland, top-down 3/4 cozy 32px pixel life simulator. Four well separated equal columns in a single row with wide transparent margins, exact same scale. Columns: 1 empty side-view mine cart with cedar slats copper rims and 2 dark iron wheels pointing right; 2 identical cart filled with golden ore lumps, wheel spoke alternate orientation; 3 isolated wood crate with dark slate and gold ore visible; 4 short wooden delivery post with copper edged ore-cart symbol, no text. Hard pixel edges, limited warm palette, crisp game assets, isolated props without floor/platform/shadows/letters/UI. Avoid overlap and preserve full alpha transparency around sprites.

One isolated cozy Taiwanese 32px pixel game inventory icon, angled view of a small angular charcoal gray rock specimen crossed by one narrow ochre-gold vein, displayed atop a low dark walnut museum sample plinth with a tiny copper fastener. Compact silhouette. The rock is mostly gray, clearly a mounted mineral sample, no logs, no gold ingot, no glass case. Crisp chunky pixel edges, limited warm palette, no letters or background, alpha outside.
assets.integration: Godot work/generate_gold_sample.gd trims the alpha bounds, fits within 28×28 using nearest sampling, and centers in a 32×32 transparent canvas.
